patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero section with primary text and interactive CTA cards on one side, balanced by a dynamic image collage with abstract shapes on the other.
Clear typographic hierarchy with large, bold serif headings for impact and legible sans-serif for body text, creating strong contrast and readability.
A vibrant, optimistic green accent color is used strategically for CTAs, icons, and illustrative elements against a largely neutral palette of white, light grey, and dark blue.
Content sections and individual elements (like cards and illustrations) reveal themselves with a subtle fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport during scroll.
The primary navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport, maintaining consistent access to site navigation without visual transformation.
Subject category sections are presented as expandable accordion-like cards within a grid, each with a distinct icon and detailed sub-topics.

technique_notes: Uses scroll-triggered animations to progressively reveal content sections and individual elements with a gentle fade and slight upward translation as they become visible in the viewport, enhancing engagement (likely using locomotive-scroll).
The main navigation bar is implemented as a sticky element that remains fixed at the top of the browser window throughout the scroll, ensuring persistent access to key site functions.
Interactive call-to-action cards in the hero section are styled as distinct, subtly rounded buttons with an arrow indicator, inviting user interaction to select a role.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, impactful serif headings (~3-4x body) with clear hierarchy, complemented by a clean, readable sans-serif for body text and smaller labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (small border-radius) applied consistently to buttons, input fields, and content cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy with generous vertical spacing between major sections, balanced by a more compact layout within content cards and the footer.

standout: The site's distinctive blend of playful, hand-drawn-style illustrations and abstract shapes with a clean, structured layout creates an approachable yet authoritative educational experience. The visual storytelling through collages and dynamic elements makes complex information feel engaging and accessible.
